description: Twitter API: User Tweets: the latest public tweets of one X (Twitter) account by handle or x.com URL, newest first. Per tweet the text, author handle and name, verification, followers, likes, replies, retweets, views, language, reply or quote parent, time and URL in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

handle.description: An X handle (with or without @) or an x.com profile URL.

name: x_posts
title: X (Twitter) user timeline
